''Béticos'' (supporters) | stadium = [[Estadio La Cartuja]]{{Cite web|url=https://betismevoycontigo.es/|title=Me voy contigo|website=betismevoycontigo.es|language=Spanish|access-date=7 July 2025}} | capacity = 70,000 | image = Real Betis 2022 logo.svg | upright = 0.9 | fullname = Real Betis Balompié, [[Sociedad Anónima Deportiva|S.A.D.]] | short name = Betis | founded = {{Start date and age|1907|9|12|df=y}} (as ''Sevilla Balompié'') | chairman = [[:es:Ángel Haro|Ángel Haro]] | chrtitle = President | manager = [[Manuel Pellegrini]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Spanish football updater|Real Betis}} | season = {{Spanish football updater|Real Betis2}} | position = {{Spanish football updater|Real Betis3}} | pattern_la1 = _betis2627h | pattern_b1 = _betis2627h | pattern_ra1 = _betis2627h | pattern_sh1 = _betis2627h | pattern_so1 = _betis2627hl | leftarm1 = 359B5C | body1 = 359B5C | rightarm1 = 359B5C | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = 359B5C | pattern_la2 = _betis2627a | pattern_b2 = _betis2627a | pattern_ra2 = _betis2627a | pattern_sh2 = _betis2627a | pattern_so2 = _betis2627al | leftarm2 = 005c29 | body2 = 005c29 | rightarm2 = 005c29 | shorts2 = 005c29 | socks2 = 005c29 | pattern_la3 = _betis2627t | pattern_b3 = _betis2627t | pattern_ra3 = _betis2627t | pattern_sh3 = _betis2627t | pattern_so3 = _betis2627tl | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = | current = 2026–27 Real Betis season | website = {{URL|https://en.realbetisbalompie.es/|realbetisbalompie.es}} }} {{Real Betis sections}} '''Real Betis Balompié, S.A.D.''', known as '''Real Betis''' ({{IPA|es|reˈal ˈbetis|pron}}), is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Seville]], [[Andalusia]], Spain. They compete in [[La Liga]], the [[Spanish football league system|top flight of Spanish football]]. Traditionally, Real Betis play home matches at [[Estadio Benito Villamarín]]. However, since 2025, the club have played their home games at the 70,000-seat [[Estadio La Cartuja]] while awaiting the completion of a €262 million redevelopment of their traditional home.{{Cite web|url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/news/laliga-top-10-stadiums-power-13974425|title=We ranked the top 10 stadium in La Liga – with a surprise No.1|last=Jones|first=Rich|date=9 February 2019|website=Mirror|access-date=25 January 2020|archive-date=24 January 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200124174143/https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/news/laliga-top-10-stadiums-power-13974425|url-status=live}} Real Betis won the league title in [[1934–35 La Liga|1935]] and the [[Copa del Rey]] in [[1976–77 Copa del Rey|1977]], [[2004–05 Copa del Rey|2005]] and [[2021–22 Copa del Rey|2022]]. Given the club's tumultuous history and many relegations, its motto is ''¡Viva el Betis manque pierda!'' ({{lang|es|Long live Betis even when they lose!}}).{{cite news|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/clubfootball/news/newsid=109997.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090414102617/http://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/clubfootball/news/newsid=109997.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=14 April 2009|title=Real Betis, 100 years of passion|publisher=FIFA|date=18 January 2007|access-date=27 April 2011}}"}}
